name: silence_cut
description: Find the silent parts of a video or audio recording (action detect, default), or remove them (action remove) to tighten talking-head videos, tutorials and podcasts with automatic jump cuts. Sound quieter than threshold_db for at least min_silence counts as silence; padding keeps a little air around speech so cuts sound natural.

input.description: Path of the audio or video file, relative to the workspace.

action.description: detect (default) lists the silences; remove cuts them out.

threshold_db.description: Anything quieter than this (in dB) is silence. Default -35; use -45 for quiet recordings, -25 for noisy ones.

min_silence.description: Shortest pause to count, default 0.6 seconds. Time as seconds ("90", "12.5") or clock time ("1:30", "01:02:03.5").

padding.description: Audio kept on each side of a cut, default 0.15 seconds. Time as seconds ("90", "12.5") or clock time ("1:30", "01:02:03.5").

output.description: Path for the result, relative to the workspace. The extension picks the format. Default: next to the input as <name>_nosilence.<ext>. An existing file is never replaced unless overwrite is true.

quality.description: Encoding quality when re-encoding: high (visually lossless, larger files), medium, or low (smallest). Default high.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Default false.
